Answer: B
Reason: Figure 2 demonstrates a visible visceral pleural line in the right hemithorax with an absence of lung markings peripheral to it, which is diagnostic of a pneumothorax. This finding explains the sudden clinical worsening and right-sided chest pain, whereas Figure 1 shows only nonspecific parenchymal opacities consistent with the underlying COVID-19 pneumonia.
